intended_object: A canonical isomorphism, used inside the proof, between two models of the Mayer–Vietoris short exact sequence of singular chain complexes for two open sets U, V. One model uses chains on U∩V, on U⊕V and on U∪V ("small"); the other uses subcomplexes of the chains of the ambient space X. This is inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: This definition is not a mathematical object in its own right. It is bookkeeping data: an isomorphism of `ShortComplex`es assembled from three component chain isomorphisms. The library uses it to move between two internal models of the same short complex while it builds the Mayer–Vietoris sequence. The places it is used are the swap isomorphism at line 646 and computations around line 1590. No standard mathematical notion would be formalized by it, so there is nothing to judge for faithfulness or generality.
